data.one_liner: Config-driven CLI to generate launcher icons and splash screens from a single SVG.
data.what_it_does: flutter_adaptive_studio is a command-line tool that generates adaptive app icons, themed icons, iOS app icon sets, native Android/iOS splash screens, and an optional in-app Flutter splash from a single SVG file. It parses configuration files and safely updates native resources.
use_when: You want to generate both launcher icons and splash screens from a single SVG source.
You need Android adaptive icons, Android 13 monochrome icons, and iOS 18 dark/tinted app icons.
You want to configure flavors easily with deep-merging resource overlays.
avoid_when: Your project targets the web and you require the generated in-app splash to run there without platform guarding.
You strictly want a Flutter runtime plugin rather than a CLI tool.
strengths: Vector-native pipeline avoids manual PNG resizing and fits art into the adaptive safe zone automatically.
Generates both launcher icons and splash screens for Android and iOS simultaneously.
Idempotent CLI tool with safe native XML and plist parsing.
weaknesses: iOS launch screens are static due to Apple design limits.
In-app splash Android-API gate uses dart:ffi, making it a no-op on web.
data.setup_notes: Install globally via `dart pub global activate flutter_adaptive_studio`, run `fas init` to create the configuration file, and set `compileSdk` to 34 in `android/app/build.gradle` for the Android splash.
